reason: @stll/property-testing/dom-environment is the single owner of DOM test teardown for apps/web and packages/ui: it calls GlobalRegistrator.unregister from @happy-dom/global-registrator and resolves React's scheduler through react-dom, so the package declares both. Both already resolve to the same versions in apps/web and packages/ui (no new lockfile packages), and the move deletes the duplicate teardown copies those packages carried.
